name: Outdoors
description: Living things and small events to play: birds at dawn, crickets, a frog pond, a stream, distant thunder and wind chimes, synthesised live. Hold a key to open the scene; more keys layer more of it, and the key's pitch tunes what is pitched.

params.name: Type
params.description: Which scene plays: a dawn chorus of songbirds, a field of crickets, frogs calling across a pond, a running stream, a distant thunderstorm or wind chimes tuned to the keys you hold.

params.name: Density
params.description: How much is going on: how many birds, crickets or frogs are calling and how often, how fast the water runs, how often thunder rolls or the chimes are struck.

params.name: Distance
params.description: How far away the scene is. Near is bright, dry and distinct; far is duller, softer at the edges and more uneven in level, as if heard across a field.

params.name: Movement
params.description: How much the scene changes over time: gusts in the chimes, waves of activity among the animals, surges in the stream. At zero it holds steady.

params.name: Tone
params.description: Colour of the scene, from dark and mellow to bright. The key's pitch leans it as well: low keys give bigger, lower creatures and deeper water.

params.name: Attack
params.description: How long the scene takes to fade in when a key is pressed.

params.name: Release
params.description: How long the scene takes to fade out after the key is released.

params.name: Width
params.description: How far the sources spread across the stereo field. At full every creature and chime has its own place; at zero the scene folds to mono.

params.name: Volume
params.description: Output level of the instrument. A soft clip after it rounds off the peaks when many keys stack up.
